summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules. The returns report a share repurchase of 131,796 American depositary shares (representing 131,796 Class A ordinary shares) at USD 22.86 per share on May 20, 2026, representing 0.02% of total outstanding shares, and confirm an opening balance of 563,800,693 Class A ordinary shares. The filing is a routine disclosure of an open-market share buyback program. The Form 6-K serves as a foreign private issuer's equivalent of a current report. No special-situation event such as a tender offer or strategic change is indicated.
